text: Progress + release note (worker-1, 2026-09-04): the FULL scope landed across commits 19f5192ebc (legacy deletion: SlotClaim::encode/encode_canonical/decode/into_raw + KEY_CLAIM_*, -357 lines), f5c9359f7d (handle_post_slots rewire to RawSlotClaim::from_cose + validate_claim_timing on required expiry i64::try_from->4.03; lichend + end_to_end helper migration to encode_cose), eaa719bc14 (review fixes: encode_cose doc + end_to_end expiry now+100, unused sign imports). encode_cose now REQUIRES ordinal (MissingField('ordinal'), after the slots-order check so the unsorted-slots test expectation is unchanged). REMAINING: end_to_end runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim RED deliberately - spec 106B envelope cannot fit the single-frame SCHC budget (global path coap<=155, envelope needs >=163); decision bead project-LICHEN-worker6-ljgs (human), completion bead .16.2.6 (blocked).
